headline: Drake is allegedly set to sign one of the BIGGEST record deals in music history with UMG,
body: Drake is allegedly set to sign one of the BIGGEST record deals in music history with UMG, according to “This is definitely official. Drake is at the precipisce of being in a new deal. He’s set to receive probably the biggest record deal in history. ” Drake completed his massive $400 million deal with UMG by dropping his three surprise albums (‘Iceman,’ ‘Habibti,’ and ‘Maid of Honour’) in May 2026—fulfilling his contractual album requirements. How much will Drake sign for?
